<div class="concept-line fragment fade-up" style="margin-top:.8em;">Now that we know what a statistical test <em>is</em>, we can choose the right one for the data and question.</div>

<script>
(function () {

/* =========================================================
   CORE MATH HELPERS
   ========================================================= */

let ciSeed = 0;
let propSeed = 0;
let trialSeed = 0;

function clamp(x, a, b) {
  return Math.max(a, Math.min(b, x));
}

function mulberry32(seed) {
  return function () {
    let t = seed += 0x6D2B79F5;
    t = Math.imul(t ^ t >>> 15, t | 1);
    t ^= t + Math.imul(t ^ t >>> 7, t | 61);
    return ((t ^ t >>> 14) >>> 0) / 4294967296;
  };
}

function randn(rng) {
  let u = 0;
  let v = 0;
  while (u === 0) u = rng();
  while (v === 0) v = rng();
  return Math.sqrt(-2 * Math.log(u)) * Math.cos(2 * Math.PI * v);
}

function erf(x) {
  const sign = x < 0 ? -1 : 1;
  x = Math.abs(x);
  const a1 = 0.254829592;
  const a2 = -0.284496736;
  const a3 = 1.421413741;
  const a4 = -1.453152027;
  const a5 = 1.061405429;
  const p = 0.3275911;
  const t = 1 / (1 + p * x);
  const y = 1 - (((((a5 * t + a4) * t) + a3) * t + a2) * t + a1) * t * Math.exp(-x * x);
  return sign * y;
}

function normCdf(x, mu = 0, sigma = 1) {
  return 0.5 * (1 + erf((x - mu) / (sigma * Math.sqrt(2))));
}

/* Acklam inverse-normal approximation */
function normInv(p) {
  if (p <= 0) return -Infinity;
  if (p >= 1) return Infinity;

  const a = [
    -3.969683028665376e+01,
     2.209460984245205e+02,
    -2.759285104469687e+02,
     1.383577518672690e+02,
    -3.066479806614716e+01,
     2.506628277459239e+00
  ];
  const b = [
    -5.447609879822406e+01,
     1.615858368580409e+02,
    -1.556989798598866e+02,
     6.680131188771972e+01,
    -1.328068155288572e+01
  ];
  const c = [
    -7.784894002430293e-03,
    -3.223964580411365e-01,
    -2.400758277161838e+00,
    -2.549732539343734e+00,
     4.374664141464968e+00,
     2.938163982698783e+00
  ];
  const d = [
     7.784695709041462e-03,
     3.224671290700398e-01,
     2.445134137142996e+00,
     3.754408661907416e+00
  ];

  const plow = 0.02425;
  const phigh = 1 - plow;
  let q;
  let r;

  if (p < plow) {
    q = Math.sqrt(-2 * Math.log(p));
    return (((((c[0] * q + c[1]) * q + c[2]) * q + c[3]) * q + c[4]) * q + c[5]) /
      ((((d[0] * q + d[1]) * q + d[2]) * q + d[3]) * q + 1);
  }

  if (p > phigh) {
    q = Math.sqrt(-2 * Math.log(1 - p));
    return -(((((c[0] * q + c[1]) * q + c[2]) * q + c[3]) * q + c[4]) * q + c[5]) /
      ((((d[0] * q + d[1]) * q + d[2]) * q + d[3]) * q + 1);
  }

  q = p - 0.5;
  r = q * q;
  return (((((a[0] * r + a[1]) * r + a[2]) * r + a[3]) * r + a[4]) * r + a[5]) * q /
    (((((b[0] * r + b[1]) * r + b[2]) * r + b[3]) * r + b[4]) * r + 1);
}

function svgLine(x1, y1, x2, y2, cls) {
  return `<line x1="${x1}" y1="${y1}" x2="${x2}" y2="${y2}" class="${cls}"></line>`;
}

function svgPath(points, cls) {
  if (!points.length) return "";
  const d = points.map((p, i) => `${i ? "L" : "M"} ${p[0].toFixed(1)} ${p[1].toFixed(1)}`).join(" ");
  return `<path d="${d}" class="${cls}"></path>`;
}

function formatP(p) {
  if (p < 0.001) return "< 0.001";
  return p.toFixed(3);
}

/* =========================================================
   NORMAL-MEAN CI COVERAGE LAB
   ========================================================= */

function renderMeanCI() {

  const svg =
    document.getElementById("ciMeanSvg");

  if (!svg) return;


  const mu =
    Number(
      document.getElementById("ciMu")?.value || 0
    );

  const sigma =
    Number(
      document.getElementById("ciSigma")?.value || 2
    );

  const n =
    Number(
      document.getElementById("ciN")?.value || 20
    );

  const levelPct =
    Number(
      document.getElementById("ciLevel")?.value || 95
    );

  const type =
    document.getElementById("ciType")?.value || "two";

  const k =
    Number(
      document.getElementById("ciK")?.value || 100
    );


  /* -------------------------------------------------------
     Update displayed control values
     ------------------------------------------------------- */

  const muOut =
    document.getElementById("ciMuValue");

  const sigmaOut =
    document.getElementById("ciSigmaValue");

  const nOut =
    document.getElementById("ciNValue");

  const levelOut =
    document.getElementById("ciLevelValue");


  if (muOut) {
    muOut.textContent =
      mu.toFixed(1);
  }

  if (sigmaOut) {
    sigmaOut.textContent =
      sigma.toFixed(1);
  }

  if (nOut) {
    nOut.textContent =
      n;
  }

  if (levelOut) {
    levelOut.textContent =
      `${levelPct}%`;
  }


  /* -------------------------------------------------------
     Sampling distribution
     ------------------------------------------------------- */

  const level =
    levelPct / 100;

  const se =
    sigma / Math.sqrt(n);


  /*
   * IMPORTANT:
   *
   * Do not let mu, sigma, n or confidence change the seed.
   *
   * Moving sliders therefore transforms the SAME underlying
   * repeated samples instead of silently drawing a new set.
   */

  const rng =
    mulberry32(
      6100 +
      ciSeed * 1009
    );


  let z;

  if (levelPct === 100) {

    z = Infinity;

  } else {

    const alpha =
      1 - level;

    z =
      type === "two"
        ? normInv(1 - alpha / 2)
        : normInv(1 - alpha);
  }


  const intervals = [];

  let covered = 0;


  for (let i = 0; i < k; i++) {

    /*
     * Same standardized random draw,
     * transformed according to current SE.
     */

    const mean =
      mu +
      se * randn(rng);


    let lo =
      -Infinity;

    let hi =
      Infinity;


    if (levelPct === 100) {

      /*
       * 100% confidence:
       * the interval must cover the entire real line.
       */

      lo = -Infinity;
      hi = Infinity;

    } else if (type === "two") {

      lo =
        mean -
        z * se;

      hi =
        mean +
        z * se;

    } else if (type === "lower") {

      lo =
        mean -
        z * se;

      hi =
        Infinity;

    } else {

      lo =
        -Infinity;

      hi =
        mean +
        z * se;
    }


    const covers =
      mu >= lo &&
      mu <= hi;


    if (covers) {
      covered++;
    }


    intervals.push({
      mean,
      lo,
      hi,
      covers
    });
  }


  /* -------------------------------------------------------
     Coverage output
     ------------------------------------------------------- */

  const coverageOut =
    document.getElementById("ciCoverage");


  if (coverageOut) {

    coverageOut.textContent =
      `${(
        100 *
        covered /
        k
      ).toFixed(1)}%`;
  }


  /* -------------------------------------------------------
     FIXED plotting geometry
     ------------------------------------------------------- */

  const W = 900;
  const H = 608;

  const left = 70;
  const right = 870;

  const top = 28;
  const base = 555;


  /*
   * Fixed horizontal domain.
   *
   * This is the key change:
   * students now SEE intervals shrink/grow.
   */

  const xMin = -10;
  const xMax = 10;


  const mapX = x =>
    left +
    ((x - xMin) /
    (xMax - xMin)) *
    (right - left);


  /*
   * Clip finite values to visible plotting domain.
   */

  const clipX = x =>
    Math.max(
      xMin,
      Math.min(
        xMax,
        x
      )
    );


  /* -------------------------------------------------------
     Axes
     ------------------------------------------------------- */

  let html = "";


  html +=
    svgLine(
      left,
      base,
      right,
      base,
      "lab-axis"
    );


  const ticks = [
    -10,
    -5,
    0,
    5,
    10
  ];


  ticks.forEach(tick => {

    const x =
      mapX(tick);


    html += `
      <line
        x1="${x}"
        y1="${base}"
        x2="${x}"
        y2="${base + 7}"
        class="lab-axis-tick">
      </line>

      <text
        x="${x}"
        y="${base + 24}"
        text-anchor="middle"
        class="lab-axis-label">
        ${tick}
      </text>
    `;
  });


  /* -------------------------------------------------------
     True population mean
     ------------------------------------------------------- */

  const truthX =
    mapX(mu);


  html +=
    svgLine(
      truthX,
      top - 4,
      truthX,
      base,
      "lab-truth-line"
    );


  html += `
    <text
      x="${truthX + 6}"
      y="${top + 12}"
      class="lab-truth-label"
      style="font-size: 0.4em; font-weight: 600;">
      true μ = ${mu.toFixed(1)}
    </text>
  `;


  /* -------------------------------------------------------
     Draw ALL intervals
     ------------------------------------------------------- */

  const usableHeight =
    base - top;


  /*
   * Intervals fill the complete vertical space.
   *
   * A small deterministic jitter prevents rows from forming
   * an excessively rigid raster, especially at k = 1000.
   */

  intervals.forEach((d, i) => {

    const fraction =
      (i + 0.5) / k;


    const basicY =
      top +
      fraction * usableHeight;


    /*
     * deterministic pseudo-jitter:
     * approximately ±0.35 row spacing
     */

    const nominalSpacing =
      usableHeight / k;


    const jitter =
      Math.sin(
        (i + 1) *
        12.9898
      ) *
      nominalSpacing *
      0.35;


    const y =
      basicY +
      jitter;


    const cls =
      d.covers
        ? "ci-cover"
        : "ci-miss";


    /*
     * 100% confidence:
     *
     * show visually as -Inf ... +Inf.
     */

    if (levelPct === 100) {

      html +=
        svgLine(
          left,
          y,
          right,
          y,
          cls
        );


      html += `
        <polyline
          points="
            ${left + 8},${y - 3}
            ${left},${y}
            ${left + 8},${y + 3}
          "
          class="${cls}">
        </polyline>

        <polyline
          points="
            ${right - 8},${y - 3}
            ${right},${y}
            ${right - 8},${y + 3}
          "
          class="${cls}">
        </polyline>
      `;

    } else if (type === "two") {

      const loVisible =
        clipX(d.lo);

      const hiVisible =
        clipX(d.hi);


      html +=
        svgLine(
          mapX(loVisible),
          y,
          mapX(hiVisible),
          y,
          cls
        );


      /*
       * Arrowheads indicate interval continues
       * beyond the fixed plot limits.
       */

      if (d.lo < xMin) {

        html += `
          <polyline
            points="
              ${left + 8},${y - 3}
              ${left},${y}
              ${left + 8},${y + 3}
            "
            class="${cls}">
          </polyline>
        `;
      }


      if (d.hi > xMax) {

        html += `
          <polyline
            points="
              ${right - 8},${y - 3}
              ${right},${y}
              ${right - 8},${y + 3}
            "
            class="${cls}">
          </polyline>
        `;
      }

    } else if (type === "lower") {

      const loVisible =
        clipX(d.lo);


      html +=
        svgLine(
          mapX(loVisible),
          y,
          right,
          y,
          cls
        );


      html += `
        <polyline
          points="
            ${right - 8},${y - 3}
            ${right},${y}
            ${right - 8},${y + 3}
          "
          class="${cls}">
        </polyline>
      `;


      if (d.lo < xMin) {

        html += `
          <polyline
            points="
              ${left + 8},${y - 3}
              ${left},${y}
              ${left + 8},${y + 3}
            "
            class="${cls}">
          </polyline>
        `;
      }

    } else {

      const hiVisible =
        clipX(d.hi);


      html +=
        svgLine(
          left,
          y,
          mapX(hiVisible),
          y,
          cls
        );


      html += `
        <polyline
          points="
            ${left + 8},${y - 3}
            ${left},${y}
            ${left + 8},${y + 3}
          "
          class="${cls}">
        </polyline>
      `;


      if (d.hi > xMax) {

        html += `
          <polyline
            points="
              ${right - 8},${y - 3}
              ${right},${y}
              ${right - 8},${y + 3}
            "
            class="${cls}">
          </polyline>
        `;
      }
    }


    /*
     * Sample mean.
     *
     * Only draw it if it falls inside the fixed x-domain.
     */

    if (
      d.mean >= xMin &&
      d.mean <= xMax
    ) {

      html += `
        <circle
          cx="${mapX(d.mean)}"
          cy="${y}"
          r="1.7"
          class="ci-point">
        </circle>
      `;
    }
  });


  /* -------------------------------------------------------
     Legend, no "showing 60..." text
     ------------------------------------------------------- */

  html += `
    <text
      x="${left}"
      y="${H - 8}"
      class="lab-note"
      style="font-size: 0.6em; font-weight: 600;">
      green covers μ · red misses μ
    </text>
  `;


  svg.innerHTML =
    html;
}

/* =========================================================
   NORMAL PROBABILITY GEOMETRY
   ========================================================= */

function drawTailProbabilitySvg(svgId, type) {

  const svg =
    document.getElementById(svgId);

  if (!svg) return;


  const W = 240;
  const H = 120;

  const left = 12;
  const right = 228;
  const top = 8;
  const baseline = 91;

  const xMin = -4;
  const xMax = 4;

  const yMax = 0.43;


  const mapX = x =>
    left +
    ((x - xMin) /
    (xMax - xMin)) *
    (right - left);


  const mapY = y =>
    baseline -
    (y / yMax) *
    (baseline - top);


  /*
   * Local PDF helper.
   * Using a separate name avoids collisions with
   * the normPdf() already used elsewhere in Week 6.
   */

  function tailNormPdf(x) {
    return Math.exp(-0.5 * x * x) /
      Math.sqrt(2 * Math.PI);
  }


  function areaPath(a, b) {

    const start =
      Math.max(
        xMin,
        a
      );

    const end =
      Math.min(
        xMax,
        b
      );

    const step = 0.025;


    let d =
      `M ${mapX(start)} ${baseline}`;


    d +=
      ` L ${mapX(start)} ${mapY(tailNormPdf(start))}`;


    for (
      let x = start + step;
      x <= end;
      x += step
    ) {

      d +=
        ` L ${mapX(x)} ${mapY(tailNormPdf(x))}`;
    }


    d +=
      ` L ${mapX(end)} ${mapY(tailNormPdf(end))}`;

    d +=
      ` L ${mapX(end)} ${baseline} Z`;


    return d;
  }


  /* full Normal curve */

  let curve =
    `M ${mapX(xMin)} ${mapY(tailNormPdf(xMin))}`;

  for (
    let x = xMin + 0.025;
    x <= xMax;
    x += 0.025
  ) {

    curve +=
      ` L ${mapX(x)} ${mapY(tailNormPdf(x))}`;
  }


  let html = "";


  /*
   * 95% examples
   *
   * two-sided:
   *   central 95%, alpha/2 in each tail
   *
   * lower bound:
   *   95% to the LEFT of +1.645
   *
   * upper bound:
   *   95% to the RIGHT of -1.645
   */

  if (type === "two") {

    const z = 1.96;


    html += `
      <path
        d="${areaPath(-z, z)}"
        class="tail-main-area">
      </path>

      <path
        d="${areaPath(xMin, -z)}"
        class="tail-alpha-area">
      </path>

      <path
        d="${areaPath(z, xMax)}"
        class="tail-alpha-area">
      </path>
    `;


    html += `
      <line
        x1="${mapX(-z)}"
        y1="${mapY(tailNormPdf(-z))}"
        x2="${mapX(-z)}"
        y2="${baseline}"
        class="tail-cut">
      </line>

      <line
        x1="${mapX(z)}"
        y1="${mapY(tailNormPdf(z))}"
        x2="${mapX(z)}"
        y2="${baseline}"
        class="tail-cut">
      </line>

      <text
        x="${mapX(0)}"
        y="42"
        text-anchor="middle"
        class="tail-prob-label"
        style="font-size: 0.4em; font-weight: 600;">
        1−α
      </text>

      <text
        x="${mapX(-2.7)}"
        y="84"
        text-anchor="middle"
        class="tail-alpha-label"
        style="font-size: 0.4em; font-weight: 600;">
        α/2
      </text>

      <text
        x="${mapX(2.7)}"
        y="84"
        text-anchor="middle"
        class="tail-alpha-label"style="font-size: 0.4em; font-weight: 600;">
        α/2
      </text>
    `;

  } else if (type === "lower") {

    const z = 1.645;


    html += `
      <path
        d="${areaPath(xMin, z)}"
        class="tail-main-area">
      </path>

      <path
        d="${areaPath(z, xMax)}"
        class="tail-alpha-area">
      </path>
    `;


    html += `
      <line
        x1="${mapX(z)}"
        y1="${mapY(tailNormPdf(z))}"
        x2="${mapX(z)}"
        y2="${baseline}"
        class="tail-cut">
      </line>

      <text
        x="${mapX(-0.25)}"
        y="42"
        text-anchor="middle"
        class="tail-prob-label"
        style="font-size: 0.4em; font-weight: 600;">
        1−α
      </text>

      <text
        x="${mapX(2.65)}"
        y="84"
        text-anchor="middle"
        class="tail-alpha-label"
        style="font-size: 0.4em; font-weight: 600;">
        α
      </text>
    `;

  } else if (type === "upper") {

    const z = -1.645;


    html += `
      <path
        d="${areaPath(z, xMax)}"
        class="tail-main-area">
      </path>

      <path
        d="${areaPath(xMin, z)}"
        class="tail-alpha-area">
      </path>
    `;


    html += `
      <line
        x1="${mapX(z)}"
        y1="${mapY(tailNormPdf(z))}"
        x2="${mapX(z)}"
        y2="${baseline}"
        class="tail-cut">
      </line>

      <text
        x="${mapX(0.25)}"
        y="42"
        text-anchor="middle"
        class="tail-prob-label"
        style="font-size: 0.4em; font-weight: 600;">
        1−α
      </text>

      <text
        x="${mapX(-2.65)}"
        y="84"
        text-anchor="middle"
        class="tail-alpha-label"
        style="font-size: 0.4em; font-weight: 600;">
        α
      </text>
    `;
  }


  /* Normal curve */

  html += `
    <path
      d="${curve}"
      class="tail-curve">
    </path>
  `;


  /* baseline */

  html += `
    <line
      x1="${left}"
      y1="${baseline}"
      x2="${right}"
      y2="${baseline}"
      class="tail-axis">
    </line>
  `;


  /* zero */

  html += `
    <line
      x1="${mapX(0)}"
      y1="${baseline}"
      x2="${mapX(0)}"
      y2="${baseline + 4}"
      class="tail-axis">
    </line>

    <text
      x="${mapX(0)}"
      y="${baseline + 13}"
      text-anchor="middle"
      class="tail-label">
      0
    </text>
  `;


  svg.innerHTML = html;
}


function drawTailProbabilitySvgs() {

  drawTailProbabilitySvg(
    "tailTwoSvg",
    "two"
  );

  drawTailProbabilitySvg(
    "tailLowerSvg",
    "lower"
  );

  drawTailProbabilitySvg(
    "tailUpperSvg",
    "upper"
  );
}

/* =========================================================
   NULL-WORLD NORMAL DISTRIBUTION
   ========================================================= */

function drawNullWorldSvg() {

  const svg =
    document.getElementById("nullWorldSvg");

  if (!svg) return;


  const W = 820;
  const H = 310;

  const left = 45;
  const right = 775;
  const top = 28;
  const baseline = 260;

  const xMin = -4;
  const xMax = 4;

  const yMax = 0.43;


  const mapX = x =>
    left +
    ((x - xMin) /
    (xMax - xMin)) *
    (right - left);


  const mapY = y =>
    baseline -
    (y / yMax) *
    (baseline - top);


  function nullNormPdf(x) {

    return Math.exp(
      -0.5 * x * x
    ) /
    Math.sqrt(
      2 * Math.PI
    );
  }


  function areaPath(a, b) {

    const start =
      Math.max(
        xMin,
        a
      );

    const end =
      Math.min(
        xMax,
        b
      );

    const step = 0.02;


    let d =
      `M ${mapX(start)} ${baseline}`;


    d +=
      ` L ${mapX(start)} ${mapY(nullNormPdf(start))}`;


    for (
      let x = start + step;
      x <= end;
      x += step
    ) {

      d +=
        ` L ${mapX(x)} ${mapY(nullNormPdf(x))}`;
    }


    d +=
      ` L ${mapX(end)} ${mapY(nullNormPdf(end))}`;

    d +=
      ` L ${mapX(end)} ${baseline} Z`;


    return d;
  }


  /* full Normal curve */

  let curve =
    `M ${mapX(xMin)} ${mapY(nullNormPdf(xMin))}`;


  for (
    let x = xMin + 0.02;
    x <= xMax;
    x += 0.02
  ) {

    curve +=
      ` L ${mapX(x)} ${mapY(nullNormPdf(x))}`;
  }


  const critical = 1.96;


  let html = "";


  /* central 95% */

  html += `
    <path
      d="${areaPath(-critical, critical)}"
      class="null-central-area">
    </path>
  `;


  /* two rejection tails */

  html += `
    <path
      d="${areaPath(xMin, -critical)}"
      class="null-tail-area">
    </path>

    <path
      d="${areaPath(critical, xMax)}"
      class="null-tail-area">
    </path>
  `;


  /* Normal density */

  html += `
    <path
      d="${curve}"
      class="null-curve">
    </path>
  `;


  /* baseline */

  html += `
    <line
      x1="${left}"
      y1="${baseline}"
      x2="${right}"
      y2="${baseline}"
      class="null-axis">
    </line>
  `;


  /* decision bounds */

  [
    -critical,
    critical
  ].forEach(z => {

    html += `
      <line
        x1="${mapX(z)}"
        y1="${mapY(nullNormPdf(z))}"
        x2="${mapX(z)}"
        y2="${baseline}"
        class="decision-bound">
      </line>
    `;
  });


  /* labels */

  html += `
    <text
      x="${mapX(-critical)}"
      y="${baseline + 26}"
      text-anchor="middle"
      class="null-label">
      −1.96
    </text>

    <text
      x="${mapX(critical)}"
      y="${baseline + 26}"
      text-anchor="middle"
      class="null-label">
      +1.96
    </text>

    <text
      x="${mapX(0)}"
      y="112"
      text-anchor="middle"
      class="null-middle-label">
      95% of null-world statistics
    </text>

    <text
      x="${mapX(-2.75)}"
      y="${baseline - 18}"
      text-anchor="middle"
      class="null-tail-label">
      2.5%
    </text>

    <text
      x="${mapX(2.75)}"
      y="${baseline - 18}"
      text-anchor="middle"
      class="null-tail-label">
      2.5%
    </text>
  `;


  svg.innerHTML = html;
}

/* =========================================================
   PROPORTION CI COVERAGE LAB (WILSON)
   ========================================================= */

function binomialDraw(n, p, rng) {
  let x = 0;
  for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) if (rng() < p) x++;
  return x;
}

function wilsonInterval(x, n, level) {
  const phat = x / n;
  const alpha = 1 - level;
  const z = normInv(1 - alpha / 2);
  const z2 = z * z;
  const den = 1 + z2 / n;
  const center = (phat + z2 / (2 * n)) / den;
  const half = z * Math.sqrt(phat * (1 - phat) / n + z2 / (4 * n * n)) / den;
  return [Math.max(0, center - half), Math.min(1, center + half), phat];
}

function renderPropCI() {

  const svg =
    document.getElementById("ciPropSvg");

  if (!svg) return;


  const p =
    Number(
      document.getElementById("propP")?.value || 0.30
    );

  const n =
    Number(
      document.getElementById("propN")?.value || 40
    );

  const levelPct =
    Number(
      document.getElementById("propLevel")?.value || 95
    );

  const k =
    Number(
      document.getElementById("propK")?.value || 100
    );


  /* -------------------------------------------------------
     Update labels
     ------------------------------------------------------- */

  const pOut =
    document.getElementById("propPValue");

  const nOut =
    document.getElementById("propNValue");

  const levelOut =
    document.getElementById("propLevelValue");


  if (pOut) {
    pOut.textContent =
      p.toFixed(2);
  }

  if (nOut) {
    nOut.textContent =
      n;
  }

  if (levelOut) {
    levelOut.textContent =
      `${levelPct}%`;
  }


  /* -------------------------------------------------------
     Confidence level
     ------------------------------------------------------- */

  const level =
    levelPct / 100;

  const alpha =
    1 - level;

  const z =
    normInv(
      1 - alpha / 2
    );


  /*
   * Only the redraw button changes propSeed.
   *
   * Slider movement therefore modifies the same
   * underlying simulation rather than silently
   * starting a completely new experiment.
   */

  const rng =
    mulberry32(
      7200 +
      propSeed * 1009
    );


  const intervals = [];

  let covered = 0;


  /* -------------------------------------------------------
     Simulate repeated samples
     ------------------------------------------------------- */

  for (let sample = 0; sample < k; sample++) {

    let successes = 0;


    for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {

      if (rng() < p) {
        successes++;
      }
    }


    const phat =
      successes / n;


    /* -----------------------------------------------------
       Wilson confidence interval
       ----------------------------------------------------- */

    const z2 =
      z * z;

    const denom =
      1 +
      z2 / n;

    const center =
      (
        phat +
        z2 / (2 * n)
      ) /
      denom;

    const half =
      (
        z *
        Math.sqrt(
          phat * (1 - phat) / n +
          z2 / (4 * n * n)
        )
      ) /
      denom;


    const lo =
      Math.max(
        0,
        center - half
      );

    const hi =
      Math.min(
        1,
        center + half
      );


    const covers =
      p >= lo &&
      p <= hi;


    if (covers) {
      covered++;
    }


    intervals.push({
      phat,
      lo,
      hi,
      covers
    });
  }


  /* -------------------------------------------------------
     Coverage output
     ------------------------------------------------------- */

  const coverageOut =
    document.getElementById(
      "propCoverage"
    );


  if (coverageOut) {

    coverageOut.textContent =
      `${(
        100 *
        covered /
        k
      ).toFixed(1)}%`;
  }


  /* -------------------------------------------------------
     Plot geometry
     ------------------------------------------------------- */

  const W = 900;
  const H = 608;

  const left = 70;
  const right = 870;

  const top = 28;
  const base = 555;


  /*
   * Fixed scale: proportions always live in [0,1].
   */

  const xMin = 0;
  const xMax = 1;


  const mapX = x =>
    left +
    x *
    (right - left);


  /* -------------------------------------------------------
     Axis
     ------------------------------------------------------- */

  let html = "";


  html +=
    svgLine(
      left,
      base,
      right,
      base,
      "lab-axis"
    );


  const ticks = [
    0,
    0.25,
    0.50,
    0.75,
    1
  ];


  ticks.forEach(tick => {

    const x =
      mapX(tick);


    html += `
      <line
        x1="${x}"
        y1="${base}"
        x2="${x}"
        y2="${base + 7}"
        class="lab-axis-tick">
      </line>

      <text
        x="${x}"
        y="${base + 24}"
        text-anchor="middle"
        class="lab-axis-label">
        ${tick.toFixed(
          tick === 0 || tick === 1
            ? 0
            : 2
        )}
      </text>
    `;
  });


  /* -------------------------------------------------------
     True population proportion
     ------------------------------------------------------- */

  const truthX =
    mapX(p);


  html +=
    svgLine(
      truthX,
      top - 4,
      truthX,
      base,
      "lab-truth-line"
    );


  html += `
    <text
      x="${truthX + 6}"
      y="${top + 12}"
      class="lab-truth-label">
      true p = ${p.toFixed(2)}
    </text>
  `;


  /* -------------------------------------------------------
     Draw ALL confidence intervals
     ------------------------------------------------------- */

  const usableHeight =
    base - top;


  intervals.forEach((d, i) => {

    /*
     * Spread all k intervals across the complete
     * plotting height.
     */

    const fraction =
      (i + 0.5) / k;


    const basicY =
      top +
      fraction *
      usableHeight;


    /*
     * Small deterministic vertical jitter.
     *
     * Especially helpful for k = 500 or 1000.
     */

    const nominalSpacing =
      usableHeight / k;


    const jitter =
      Math.sin(
        (i + 1) *
        12.9898
      ) *
      nominalSpacing *
      0.35;


    const y =
      basicY +
      jitter;


    const cls =
      d.covers
        ? "ci-cover"
        : "ci-miss";


    /* interval */

    html +=
      svgLine(
        mapX(d.lo),
        y,
        mapX(d.hi),
        y,
        cls
      );


    /* observed sample proportion */

    html += `
      <circle
        cx="${mapX(d.phat)}"
        cy="${y}"
        r="1.7"
        class="ci-point">
      </circle>
    `;
  });


  /* -------------------------------------------------------
     Footer
     ------------------------------------------------------- */

  html += `
    <text
      x="${left}"
      y="${H - 8}"
      class="lab-note"
      style="font-size: 0.6em; font-weight: 600;">
      green covers p · red misses p
    </text>
  `;


  svg.innerHTML =
    html;
}

/* =========================================================
   REPEATED DRUG TRIAL
   ========================================================= */

function renderTrial() {
  const meansSvg = document.getElementById("trialMeansSvg");
  const effectSvg = document.getElementById("trialEffectSvg");
  if (!meansSvg || !effectSvg) return;

  const n = Number(document.getElementById("trialN")?.value || 80);
  const nOut = document.getElementById("trialNValue");
  if (nOut) nOut.textContent = n;

  const muC = 140;
  const muT = 134;
  const sigma = 14;
  const seMean = sigma / Math.sqrt(n);
  const seDiff = sigma * Math.sqrt(2 / n);
  const rng = mulberry32(8100 + trialSeed * 1031);
  const zC = randn(rng);
  const zT = randn(rng);
  const meanC = muC + seMean * zC;
  const meanT = muT + seMean * zT;
  const delta = meanT - meanC;
  const z = delta / seDiff;
  const p = 2 * (1 - normCdf(Math.abs(z)));
  const lo = delta - 1.96 * seDiff;
  const hi = delta + 1.96 * seDiff;
  const d = delta / sigma;

  const deltaOut = document.getElementById("trialDelta");
  const ciOut = document.getElementById("trialCI");
  const pOut = document.getElementById("trialP");
  const dOut = document.getElementById("trialD");
  if (deltaOut) deltaOut.textContent = `${delta.toFixed(1)} mmHg`;
  if (ciOut) ciOut.textContent = `[${lo.toFixed(1)}, ${hi.toFixed(1)}]`;
  if (pOut) pOut.textContent = formatP(p);
  if (dOut) dOut.textContent = d.toFixed(2);

  const left = 55;
  const right = 390;
  const top = 28;
  const base = 205;
  const yMin = 125;
  const yMax = 148;
  const mapY = y => base - ((y - yMin) / (yMax - yMin)) * (base - top);

  let meansHtml = svgLine(70, base, 350, base, "lab-axis");
  const xs = [145, 285];
  const vals = [meanC, meanT];
  const labels = ["placebo", "drug"];
  vals.forEach((v, i) => {
    const y = mapY(v);
    const yLo = mapY(v - 1.96 * seMean);
    const yHi = mapY(v + 1.96 * seMean);
    meansHtml += svgLine(xs[i], yHi, xs[i], yLo, i === 0 ? "trial-ci-placebo" : "trial-ci-drug");
    meansHtml += svgLine(xs[i] - 8, yHi, xs[i] + 8, yHi, i === 0 ? "trial-ci-placebo" : "trial-ci-drug");
    meansHtml += svgLine(xs[i] - 8, yLo, xs[i] + 8, yLo, i === 0 ? "trial-ci-placebo" : "trial-ci-drug");
    meansHtml += `<circle cx="${xs[i]}" cy="${y}" r="7" class="${i === 0 ? "trial-dot-placebo" : "trial-dot-drug"}"></circle>`;
    meansHtml += `<text x="${xs[i]}" y="232" text-anchor="middle" class="lab-axis-label" style="font-size:16px;">${labels[i]}</text>`;
    meansHtml += `<text x="${xs[i]}" y="${y - 12}" text-anchor="middle" class="trial-value-label">${v.toFixed(1)}</text>`;
  });
  meansSvg.innerHTML = meansHtml;

  const eLeft = 45;
  const eRight = 395;
  const eBase = 170;
  const xMin = -16;
  const xMax = 6;
  const mapX = x => eLeft + ((x - xMin) / (xMax - xMin)) * (eRight - eLeft);
  let effectHtml = svgLine(eLeft, eBase, eRight, eBase, "lab-axis");
  effectHtml += svgLine(mapX(0), 40, mapX(0), eBase + 8, "effect-zero-line");
  effectHtml += svgLine(mapX(lo), 112, mapX(hi), 112, "trial-effect-ci");
  effectHtml += svgLine(mapX(lo), 103, mapX(lo), 121, "trial-effect-ci");
  effectHtml += svgLine(mapX(hi), 103, mapX(hi), 121, "trial-effect-ci");
  effectHtml += `<circle cx="${mapX(delta)}" cy="112" r="8" class="trial-effect-dot"></circle>`;
  effectHtml += `<text x="${mapX(0) + 6}" y="55" class="effect-zero-label">null 0</text>`;
  effectHtml += `<text x="${mapX(delta)}" y="90" text-anchor="middle" class="trial-value-label">${delta.toFixed(1)}</text>`;
  effectHtml += `<text x="${eLeft}" y="205" class="lab-note" style="font-size:15px; font-weight:600;">95% CI for treatment − placebo</text>`;
  effectSvg.innerHTML = effectHtml;
}

/* =========================================================
   TYPE I / TYPE II / POWER LAB
   ========================================================= */

function normalPdf(x, mu, sigma) {
  const z = (x - mu) / sigma;
  return Math.exp(-0.5 * z * z) / (sigma * Math.sqrt(2 * Math.PI));
}

function areaPath(xs, mapX, mapY, base, cls) {
  if (!xs.length) return "";
  const topPts = xs.map(([x, y]) => [mapX(x), mapY(y)]);
  let d = `M ${topPts[0][0].toFixed(1)} ${base.toFixed(1)} `;
  topPts.forEach(p => { d += `L ${p[0].toFixed(1)} ${p[1].toFixed(1)} `; });
  d += `L ${topPts[topPts.length - 1][0].toFixed(1)} ${base.toFixed(1)} Z`;
  return `<path d="${d}" class="${cls}"></path>`;
}

/* =========================================================
   ERROR-WIDGET NORMAL HELPERS
   ========================================================= */

function errorNormPdf(x, mu = 0, sigma = 1) {

  const z =
    (x - mu) / sigma;

  return Math.exp(
    -0.5 * z * z
  ) / (
    sigma *
    Math.sqrt(2 * Math.PI)
  );
}


function errorErf(x) {

  const sign =
    x < 0 ? -1 : 1;

  x =
    Math.abs(x);

  const a1 = 0.254829592;
  const a2 = -0.284496736;
  const a3 = 1.421413741;
  const a4 = -1.453152027;
  const a5 = 1.061405429;
  const p = 0.3275911;

  const t =
    1 / (1 + p * x);

  const y =
    1 -
    (
      (
        (
          (
            (
              a5 * t +
              a4
            ) * t +
            a3
          ) * t +
          a2
        ) * t +
        a1
      ) * t
    ) *
    Math.exp(-x * x);

  return sign * y;
}


function errorNormCdf(x, mu = 0, sigma = 1) {

  return 0.5 *
    (
      1 +
      errorErf(
        (x - mu) /
        (
          sigma *
          Math.SQRT2
        )
      )
    );
}

function renderErrorWidget() {

  const svg =
    document.getElementById("errorSvg");

  if (!svg) return;


  const mu0 =
    Number(
      document.getElementById("errMu0")?.value || 0
    );

  const mu1 =
    Number(
      document.getElementById("errMu1")?.value || -4
    );

  const sigma =
    Number(
      document.getElementById("errSigma")?.value || 14
    );

  const n =
    Number(
      document.getElementById("errN")?.value || 80
    );

  const alpha =
    Number(
      document.getElementById("errAlpha")?.value || 0.05
    );

  const type =
    document.getElementById("errType")?.value || "two";


  /* -------------------------------------------------------
     Live labels
     ------------------------------------------------------- */

  const mu0Out =
    document.getElementById("errMu0Value");

  const mu1Out =
    document.getElementById("errMu1Value");

  const sigmaOut =
    document.getElementById("errSigmaValue");

  const nOut =
    document.getElementById("errNValue");


  if (mu0Out) {
    mu0Out.textContent =
      mu0.toFixed(1);
  }

  if (mu1Out) {
    mu1Out.textContent =
      mu1.toFixed(1);
  }

  if (sigmaOut) {
    sigmaOut.textContent =
      sigma.toFixed(0);
  }

  if (nOut) {
    nOut.textContent =
      n;
  }


  /* -------------------------------------------------------
     H0 and H1 must actually differ
     ------------------------------------------------------- */

  const alphaOut =
    document.getElementById("errAlphaOut");

  const betaOut =
    document.getElementById("errBetaOut");

  const powerOut =
    document.getElementById("errPowerOut");


  if (alphaOut) {
    alphaOut.textContent =
      `${(alpha * 100).toFixed(1)}%`;
  }


  if (
    Math.abs(mu1 - mu0) <
    1e-10
  ) {

    if (betaOut) {
      betaOut.textContent = "—";
    }

    if (powerOut) {
      powerOut.textContent = "—";
    }


    svg.innerHTML = `
      <text
        x="430"
        y="225"
        text-anchor="middle"
        class="error-coincide-title">
        Two worlds coincide
      </text>

      <text
        x="430"
        y="260"
        text-anchor="middle"
        class="error-coincide-sub">
        H₀ and H₁ must represent different parameter values.
      </text>
    `;

    return;
  }


  /* -------------------------------------------------------
     Sampling distribution of treatment-effect estimator
     
     n = patients per arm
     common SD = sigma
     
     SE(delta-hat) = sigma * sqrt(2/n)
     ------------------------------------------------------- */

  const se =
    sigma *
    Math.sqrt(
      2 / n
    );


  /* -------------------------------------------------------
     Decision boundaries
     ------------------------------------------------------- */

  let lowerCrit =
    -Infinity;

  let upperCrit =
    Infinity;


  if (type === "two") {

    const z =
      normInv(
        1 - alpha / 2
      );

    lowerCrit =
      mu0 -
      z * se;

    upperCrit =
      mu0 +
      z * se;

  } else if (type === "less") {

    const z =
      normInv(
        alpha
      );

    upperCrit =
      mu0 +
      z * se;

  } else {

    const z =
      normInv(
        1 - alpha
      );

    lowerCrit =
      mu0 +
      z * se;
  }


  /* -------------------------------------------------------
     Type II error under alternative world
     ------------------------------------------------------- */

  let beta;


  if (type === "two") {

    beta =
      errorNormCdf(
        upperCrit,
        mu1,
        se
      ) -
      errorNormCdf(
        lowerCrit,
        mu1,
        se
      );

  } else if (type === "less") {

    beta =
      1 -
      errorNormCdf(
        upperCrit,
        mu1,
        se
      );

  } else {

    beta =
      errorNormCdf(
        lowerCrit,
        mu1,
        se
      );
  }


  beta =
    Math.max(
      0,
      Math.min(
        1,
        beta
      )
    );


  const power =
    1 - beta;


  if (betaOut) {

    betaOut.textContent =
      `${(
        beta * 100
      ).toFixed(1)}%`;
  }


  if (powerOut) {

    powerOut.textContent =
      `${(
        power * 100
      ).toFixed(1)}%`;
  }


  /* -------------------------------------------------------
     Fixed plotting geometry
     ------------------------------------------------------- */

  const W = 860;
  const H = 500;

  const left = 58;
  const right = 830;

  const top = 28;
  const baseline = 350;


  /*
   * CRITICAL CHANGE:
   * fixed x-axis
   */

  const xMin = -15;
  const xMax = 15;


  const mapX = x =>
    left +
    ((x - xMin) /
    (xMax - xMin)) *
    (right - left);


  const clipX = x =>
    Math.max(
      xMin,
      Math.min(
        xMax,
        x
      )
    );


  /*
   * y-scale accommodates both curves but does NOT
   * change their horizontal width.
   */

  const peak =
    errorNormPdf(
      mu0,
      mu0,
      se
    );

  const yMax =
    peak * 1.12;


  const mapY = y =>
    baseline -
    (y / yMax) *
    (baseline - top);


  /* -------------------------------------------------------
     Density curve builder
     ------------------------------------------------------- */

  function curvePath(mu) {

    const step = 0.05;

    let d =
      `M ${mapX(xMin)} ${mapY(errorNormPdf(xMin, mu, se))}`;


    for (
      let x = xMin + step;
      x <= xMax;
      x += step
    ) {

      d +=
        ` L ${mapX(x)} ${mapY(errorNormPdf(x, mu, se))}`;
    }

    return d;
  }


  /* -------------------------------------------------------
     Filled probability area
     ------------------------------------------------------- */

  function areaPath(
    mu,
    a,
    b
  ) {

    const start =
      Math.max(
        xMin,
        a
      );

    const end =
      Math.min(
        xMax,
        b
      );


    if (end <= start) {
      return "";
    }


    const step = 0.05;


    let d =
      `M ${mapX(start)} ${baseline}`;

    d +=
      ` L ${mapX(start)} ${mapY(errorNormPdf(start, mu, se))}`;


    for (
      let x = start + step;
      x <= end;
      x += step
    ) {

      d +=
        ` L ${mapX(x)} ${mapY(errorNormPdf(x, mu, se))}`;
    }


    d +=
      ` L ${mapX(end)} ${mapY(errorNormPdf(end, mu, se))}`;

    d +=
      ` L ${mapX(end)} ${baseline} Z`;


    return d;
  }


  /* -------------------------------------------------------
     Double-arrow region helper
     ------------------------------------------------------- */

  function regionArrow(
    x1,
    x2,
    y,
    label
  ) {

    x1 =
      Math.max(
        left,
        Math.min(
          right,
          x1
        )
      );

    x2 =
      Math.max(
        left,
        Math.min(
          right,
          x2
        )
      );


    if (
      x2 - x1 <
      18
    ) {
      return "";
    }


    const head = 7;


    return `
      <line
        x1="${x1 + head}"
        y1="${y}"
        x2="${x2 - head}"
        y2="${y}"
        class="error-region-arrow">
      </line>

      <polyline
        points="
          ${x1 + head},${y - 5}
          ${x1},${y}
          ${x1 + head},${y + 5}
        "
        class="error-region-arrow">
      </polyline>

      <polyline
        points="
          ${x2 - head},${y - 5}
          ${x2},${y}
          ${x2 - head},${y + 5}
        "
        class="error-region-arrow">
      </polyline>

      <text
        x="${(x1 + x2) / 2}"
        y="${y + 23}"
        text-anchor="middle"
        class="error-region-label">
        ${label}
      </text>
    `;
  }


  let html = "";


  /* =======================================================
     ERROR REGIONS
     ======================================================= */


  if (type === "two") {

    /*
     * Type I:
     * rejection tails under H0
     */

    html += `
      <path
        d="${areaPath(
          mu0,
          xMin,
          lowerCrit
        )}"
        class="error-null-area">
      </path>

      <path
        d="${areaPath(
          mu0,
          upperCrit,
          xMax
        )}"
        class="error-null-area">
      </path>
    `;


    /*
     * Type II:
     * non-rejection region under H1
     */

    html += `
      <path
        d="${areaPath(
          mu1,
          lowerCrit,
          upperCrit
        )}"
        class="error-beta-area">
      </path>
    `;

  } else if (type === "less") {

    html += `
      <path
        d="${areaPath(
          mu0,
          xMin,
          upperCrit
        )}"
        class="error-null-area">
      </path>

      <path
        d="${areaPath(
          mu1,
          upperCrit,
          xMax
        )}"
        class="error-beta-area">
      </path>
    `;

  } else {

    html += `
      <path
        d="${areaPath(
          mu0,
          lowerCrit,
          xMax
        )}"
        class="error-null-area">
      </path>

      <path
        d="${areaPath(
          mu1,
          xMin,
          lowerCrit
        )}"
        class="error-beta-area">
      </path>
    `;
  }


  /* =======================================================
     CURVES
     ======================================================= */

  html += `
    <path
      d="${curvePath(mu0)}"
      class="error-null-curve">
    </path>

    <path
      d="${curvePath(mu1)}"
      class="error-alt-curve">
    </path>
  `;


  /* -------------------------------------------------------
     Mean markers
     ------------------------------------------------------- */

  html += `
    <line
      x1="${mapX(mu0)}"
      y1="${mapY(errorNormPdf(mu0, mu0, se))}"
      x2="${mapX(mu0)}"
      y2="${baseline}"
      class="error-mu0-line">
    </line>

    <line
      x1="${mapX(mu1)}"
      y1="${mapY(errorNormPdf(mu1, mu1, se))}"
      x2="${mapX(mu1)}"
      y2="${baseline}"
      class="error-mu1-line">
    </line>

    <text
      x="${mapX(mu0)}"
      y="${mapY(errorNormPdf(mu0, mu0, se)) - 10}"
      text-anchor="middle"
      class="error-curve-label null">
      H₀: Δ = ${mu0.toFixed(1)}
    </text>

    <text
      x="${mapX(mu1)}"
      y="${mapY(errorNormPdf(mu1, mu1, se)) - 10}"
      text-anchor="middle"
      class="error-curve-label alt">
      H₁: Δ = ${mu1.toFixed(1)}
    </text>
  `;


  /* =======================================================
     X AXIS
     ======================================================= */

  html += `
    <line
      x1="${left}"
      y1="${baseline}"
      x2="${right}"
      y2="${baseline}"
      class="error-axis">
    </line>
  `;


  const ticks = [
    -15,
    -10,
    -5,
    0,
    5,
    10,
    15
  ];


  ticks.forEach(tick => {

    const x =
      mapX(tick);


    html += `
      <line
        x1="${x}"
        y1="${baseline}"
        x2="${x}"
        y2="${baseline + 7}"
        class="error-axis">
      </line>

      <text
        x="${x}"
        y="${baseline + 25}"
        text-anchor="middle"
        class="error-axis-label">
        ${tick}
      </text>
    `;
  });


  /* =======================================================
     DECISION BOUNDS
     ======================================================= */

  if (
    Number.isFinite(lowerCrit) &&
    lowerCrit >= xMin &&
    lowerCrit <= xMax
  ) {

    html += `
      <line
        x1="${mapX(lowerCrit)}"
        y1="${top}"
        x2="${mapX(lowerCrit)}"
        y2="${baseline}"
        class="error-critical">
      </line>
    `;
  }


  if (
    Number.isFinite(upperCrit) &&
    upperCrit >= xMin &&
    upperCrit <= xMax
  ) {

    html += `
      <line
        x1="${mapX(upperCrit)}"
        y1="${top}"
        x2="${mapX(upperCrit)}"
        y2="${baseline}"
        class="error-critical">
      </line>
    `;
  }


  /* =======================================================
     DECISION-REGION DOUBLE ARROWS
     ======================================================= */

  const arrowY =
    baseline + 52;


  if (type === "two") {

    const lc =
      mapX(
        clipX(lowerCrit)
      );

    const uc =
      mapX(
        clipX(upperCrit)
      );


    html +=
      regionArrow(
        left,
        lc,
        arrowY,
        "Reject H₀"
      );


    html +=
      regionArrow(
        lc,
        uc,
        arrowY,
        "Do not reject H₀"
      );


    html +=
      regionArrow(
        uc,
        right,
        arrowY,
        "Reject H₀"
      );

  } else if (type === "less") {

    const c =
      mapX(
        clipX(upperCrit)
      );


    html +=
      regionArrow(
        left,
        c,
        arrowY,
        "Reject H₀"
      );


    html +=
      regionArrow(
        c,
        right,
        arrowY,
        "Do not reject H₀"
      );

  } else {

    const c =
      mapX(
        clipX(lowerCrit)
      );


    html +=
      regionArrow(
        left,
        c,
        arrowY,
        "Do not reject H₀"
      );


    html +=
      regionArrow(
        c,
        right,
        arrowY,
        "Reject H₀"
      );
  }


  /* -------------------------------------------------------
     Error labels
     ------------------------------------------------------- */

  html += `
    <text
      x="${left + 10}"
      y="24"
      class="error-area-label alpha">
      red = Type I error
    </text>

    <text
      x="${left + 155}"
      y="24"
      class="error-area-label beta">
      blue = Type II error
    </text>
  `;


  svg.innerHTML =
    html;
}

/* =========================================================
   MULTIPLICITY CALCULATOR
   ========================================================= */

function renderMultiplicity() {
  const k = Number(document.getElementById("multiK")?.value || 5);
  const alpha = Number(document.getElementById("multiAlpha")?.value || 0.05);
  const fwer = 1 - Math.pow(1 - alpha, k);

  const kOut = document.getElementById("multiKValue");
  const fwerOut = document.getElementById("multiFwer");
  const fill = document.getElementById("multiFill");
  const label = document.getElementById("multiMeterLabel");
  if (kOut) kOut.textContent = k;
  if (fwerOut) fwerOut.textContent = `${(100 * fwer).toFixed(1)}%`;
  if (fill) fill.style.width = `${100 * fwer}%`;
  if (label) label.textContent = `${(100 * fwer).toFixed(1)}%`;
}

/* =========================================================
   EVENT BINDING / REVEAL INITIALIZATION
   ========================================================= */

function bindOnce(id, event, fn) {
  const el = document.getElementById(id);
  if (!el) return;
  const key = `bound${event}`;
  if (el.dataset[key] === "true") return;
  el.dataset[key] = "true";
  el.addEventListener(event, fn);
}

function initWeek06() {
  renderMeanCI();
  renderPropCI();
  renderTrial();
  renderErrorWidget();
  renderMultiplicity();
  drawTailProbabilitySvgs();
  drawNullWorldSvg();

  ["ciMu", "ciSigma", "ciN", "ciLevel"].forEach(id => bindOnce(id, "input", renderMeanCI));
  ["ciType", "ciK"].forEach(id => bindOnce(id, "change", renderMeanCI));
  bindOnce("ciRedraw", "click", function () { ciSeed++; renderMeanCI(); });

  ["propP", "propN", "propLevel"].forEach(id => bindOnce(id, "input", renderPropCI));
  bindOnce("propK", "change", renderPropCI);
  bindOnce("propRedraw", "click", function () { propSeed++; renderPropCI(); });

  bindOnce("trialN", "input", renderTrial);
  bindOnce("trialRedraw", "click", function () { trialSeed++; renderTrial(); });

  ["errMu0", "errMu1", "errSigma", "errN"].forEach(id => bindOnce(id, "input", renderErrorWidget));
  ["errAlpha", "errType"].forEach(id => bindOnce(id, "change", renderErrorWidget));

  bindOnce("multiK", "input", renderMultiplicity);
  bindOnce("multiAlpha", "change", renderMultiplicity);
}

function startWeek06() {
  requestAnimationFrame(() => requestAnimationFrame(initWeek06));
}

startWeek06();
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", startWeek06);
window.addEventListener("load", startWeek06);

if (window.Reveal && typeof window.Reveal.on === "function") {
  window.Reveal.on("ready", startWeek06);
  window.Reveal.on("slidechanged", startWeek06);
}

})();
</script>
